verdict.rationale: An llms.txt exists at deepmind.google with Veo-specific agent-oriented content: formatting rules, cinematic parameter notation, camera motion controls and lighting tokens. However, the developer API docs site returns 404 for llms.txt, and no OpenAPI spec was found, so agent-oriented coverage of the API itself is unproven. missing for 10: llms.txt on the Gemini API developer docs (ai.google.dev), machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), evidence of depth and coverage of the llms.txt content, hands-on or independent corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Operational formatting rules, cinematic parameter notation, camera motion controls, and lighting tokens for configuring text-to-video generation within the Veo framework.
